### Astrobiología

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[astrobiology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/astrobiology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific investigation of the possibility, conditions and evidence of life beyond Earth, including chemical origins, habitability and contamination risks. The methods of spacecraft observation are classified with astronomical instrumentation and evidence rather than presented as a separate astrobiological subject.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora qué podría necesitar la vida fuera de la Tierra y cómo reconocer pruebas fiables de su existencia.

#### Condiciones para la vida

Skills: 4

[conditionsForLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/conditionsForLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluating environments for life requires explicit biological and geochemical assumptions; familiar Earth conditions are useful evidence, not universal proof.

**User-friendly description (es):** Considera qué entornos y procesos químicos podrían permitir la existencia de vida.

##### Análogos de extremófilos

[extremophileAnalogues.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/extremophileAnalogues.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret how Earth organisms in extreme environments inform hypotheses about extraterrestrial habitats without proving life exists there.

**User-friendly description (es):** Usa ejemplos de vida en ambientes extremos de la Tierra para investigar posibles hábitats extraterrestres.

##### Habitabilidad

[habitability.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate energy sources, chemical building blocks, solvent availability and environmental stability as possible prerequisites for known life.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo la energía, la química, los líquidos y la estabilidad pueden hacer habitable un entorno.

##### Habitabilidad a lo largo del tiempo

[habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how a world's environmental history may change its potential to support life.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga cómo los cambios ambientales de un mundo afectan a su capacidad para albergar vida.

##### Química prebiótica

[prebioticChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/prebioticChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain plausible nonliving chemical pathways relevant to life's origins while distinguishing hypotheses from established histories.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo procesos químicos no biológicos podrían producir ingredientes relacionados con el origen de la vida.

#### Pruebas de vida

Skills: 5

[evidenceOfLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/evidenceOfLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A proposed sign of life must be weighed against nonbiological processes and the limits of the measuring instrument.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende a distinguir posibles señales de vida de explicaciones que no implican seres vivos.

##### Falsos positivos abióticos

[abioticFalsePositives.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/abioticFalsePositives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify nonbiological processes capable of producing signals superficially similar to biosignatures.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo los procesos no biológicos pueden imitar señales que parecen indicar vida.

##### Biofirmas

[biosignatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/biosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate chemical, morphological or other candidate indicators that might be produced by living systems.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce posibles indicios químicos o físicos que podrían estar relacionados con seres vivos.

##### Criterios de prueba para detectar vida

[lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish suggestive observations from convergent, independently checked evidence sufficient to support a life claim.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué las afirmaciones extraordinarias sobre vida extraterrestre requieren varias comprobaciones independientes.

##### Protección planetaria

[planetaryProtection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/planetaryProtection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why forward and backward biological contamination controls matter for mission science and credible life-detection results.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué evitar la contaminación biológica es importante al buscar vida extraterrestre.

##### Tecnofirmas

[technosignatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/technosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret possible observable indicators of technology without confusing an unexplained signal with confirmed intelligence.

**User-friendly description (es):** Considera qué podría revelar una señal inusual sobre tecnología sin llamarla prueba de inteligencia.

#### Entornos de búsqueda de vida

Skills: 3

[searchEnvironments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/searchEnvironments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Search strategies differ for nearby worlds whose material can be sampled and distant worlds known mainly through remote measurements.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara los métodos científicos para buscar vida en distintos mundos y entornos.

##### Búsqueda de vida en exoplanetas

[exoplanetLifeSearches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/exoplanetLifeSearches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the capabilities and limitations of remote atmospheric and planetary measurements in searches for life.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre qué pueden y qué no pueden revelar las mediciones de planetas lejanos sobre la posible vida.

##### Búsqueda de vida en el sistema solar

[solarSystemLifeSearches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/solarSystemLifeSearches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare scientific search approaches for places such as Mars and icy moons using expected environmental indicators.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo buscan los científicos señales de habitabilidad o vida en Marte y en lunas heladas.

##### Hábitats subsuperficiales

[subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why liquid environments protected under ice or rock can be relevant even when a surface is hostile.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué los océanos ocultos bajo el hielo o las rocas pueden ser lugares prometedores para investigar.

### Instrumentos y pruebas astronómicas

Groups: 6 · Skills: 30

[astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Astronomy infers properties of remote objects from electromagnetic radiation, gravitational effects, particles and spacecraft observations. This domain covers what an observation can reveal, how instruments and methods constrain the evidence, and how competing interpretations are evaluated, not the engineering construction of observatories and spacecraft.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo los astrónomos reúnen pruebas a partir de la luz, la gravedad, las partículas y las misiones espaciales para estudiar mundos lejanos.

#### Espectros astronómicos

Skills: 5

[astronomicalSpectra.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/astronomicalSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light encodes information about temperature, composition and motion through its distribution across wavelength and the signatures imprinted by matter.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende cómo separar la luz según sus longitudes de onda revela las propiedades de objetos lejanos.

##### Líneas espectrales de absorción

[absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dark spectral features produced by matter absorbing characteristic wavelengths from background radiation.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce las líneas oscuras del espectro como indicios de materia que absorbe luz.

##### Espectros continuos

[continuousSpectra.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/continuousSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer broad thermal properties from the distribution of emitted light across wavelengths while recognizing idealized blackbody assumptions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Usa un espectro continuo para explorar la temperatura de un objeto y la luz que emite.

##### Desplazamiento Doppler

[dopplerShift.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/dopplerShift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret wavelength shifts due to relative radial motion, distinguishing this local effect from cosmological expansion.

**User-friendly description (es):** Usa los cambios de longitud de onda para investigar el movimiento hacia el observador o en dirección contraria.

##### Líneas espectrales de emisión

[emissionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/emissionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret discrete bright features produced by matter radiating at characteristic wavelengths.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce las líneas brillantes del espectro como indicios de la materia que emite luz.

##### Observación multibanda

[multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate observations in different electromagnetic bands to distinct physical components and processes within one object.

**User-friendly description (es):** Combina imágenes y mediciones de distintas clases de luz para comprender un objeto celeste.

[standardCandles.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/standardCandles.data.ts)

[stellarParallax.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/stellarParallax.data.ts)

#### Observaciones gravitacionales y de partículas

Skills: 4

[gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational lensing, gravitational waves and astrophysical particles supply information that differs from ordinary electromagnetic imaging and spectroscopy; a multimessenger inference combines distinct independent signals. Lensing is observed through light affected by gravity and is not itself a non-electromagnetic measurement.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga cómo la gravedad y las partículas aportan pruebas que van más allá de las imágenes astronómicas habituales.

[gravitationalLensing.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/gravitationalLensing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret bending, magnification and distortion of background light by intervening gravity as evidence about mass and source geometry.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo la gravedad curva y amplifica la luz, revelando masa que de otro modo permanecería oculta.

##### Astronomía de ondas gravitacionales

[gravitationalWaveAstronomy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/gravitationalWaveAstronomy.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre qué revelan las ondas gravitacionales sobre sistemas masivos que cambian rápidamente.

[multimessengerEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/multimessengerEvidence.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Combina observaciones de luz, ondas gravitacionales y partículas para estudiar un mismo evento cósmico.

[neutrinoAstronomy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/neutrinoAstronomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how astrophysical neutrinos probe energetic processes that electromagnetic observations may not reveal.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo los neutrinos revelan fenómenos energéticos que la luz no muestra por completo.

### Mecánica celeste

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[celestialMechanics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/celestialMechanics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** This domain concerns how gravity and angular momentum govern orbital motion, rotation and mutual perturbations across planetary and stellar systems. Geometrical appearances arising from these motions are addressed separately when the observational phenomenon itself is the competency.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo la gravedad y el movimiento determinan las órbitas y rotaciones de los cuerpos en el espacio.

[gravitationalPerturbations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/gravitationalPerturbations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret departures from a simple two-body orbit caused by additional gravitational influences.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica cómo las influencias gravitatorias adicionales modifican una órbita que de otro modo sería simple.

[orbitalResonances.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/orbitalResonances.data.ts)

[tidalForces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/tidalForces.data.ts)

#### Movimiento gravitacional

Skills: 6

[gravitationalMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/gravitationalMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational interactions produce trajectories governed by mass, initial conditions and the reference frame in which motion is described.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo la gravedad gobierna el movimiento de los cuerpos celestes.

##### Movimiento baricéntrico

[barycentricMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/barycentricMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why interacting celestial bodies orbit a shared center of mass rather than one body always remaining stationary.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué dos cuerpos en órbita se mueven alrededor de un centro de masas común.

##### Primera ley de Kepler

[keplersFirstLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersFirstLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the elliptical-orbit relation, with the central gravitating body at one focus in the idealized two-body model, to the geometry of bound orbits.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce que una órbita ideal puede ser elíptica, con el cuerpo central en uno de sus focos.

##### Segunda ley de Kepler

[keplersSecondLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersSecondLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the equal-areas-in-equal-times relation to explain variation in orbital speed as an orbiting body changes its distance from the central focus.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica por qué un cuerpo en órbita se mueve más rápido cuando está más cerca del cuerpo central.

##### Tercera ley de Kepler

[keplersThirdLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersThirdLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the square of orbital period to the cube of semi-major axis with the appropriate gravitational mass dependence and limitations of the two-body model.

**User-friendly description (es):** Relaciona el período orbital de un objeto con el tamaño de su órbita y la masa que ejerce la atracción gravitatoria.

##### Energía orbital

[orbitalEnergy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/orbitalEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate gravitational potential and kinetic energy to bound and unbound orbital trajectories.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo la energía determina si una órbita permanece ligada por la gravedad o permite escapar.

##### Gravitación universal

[universalGravitation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/universalGravitation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the dependence of gravitational attraction on interacting masses and separation to astronomical situations.

**User-friendly description (es):** Usa las masas de los objetos y las distancias entre ellos para razonar sobre su atracción gravitatoria.

#### Órbitas y rotaciones

Skills: 5

[orbitsAndRotations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/orbitsAndRotations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Orbital shapes and body orientations are specified through distinct physical parameters that affect long-term celestial behavior.

**User-friendly description (es):** Describe y compara las formas, los períodos y las orientaciones de los movimientos celestes.

##### Rotación axial

[axialRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the spin of a world about its axis, including rotation period and direction, independently of the tilt or precession of that axis.

**User-friendly description (es):** Describe cómo gira un cuerpo celeste alrededor de su propio eje.

##### Inclinación axial

[axialTilt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialTilt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the angle between a body's spin axis and orbital reference direction and explain its influence on illumination geometry and seasons.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo la inclinación del eje de un mundo cambia el patrón de iluminación que recibe.

##### Elementos orbitales

[orbitalElements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalElements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret inclination, eccentricity and other orbital descriptors when comparing celestial trajectories.

**User-friendly description (es):** Interpreta los parámetros que describen la forma y orientación de una órbita.

##### Períodos orbitales

[orbitalPeriods.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalPeriods.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the time needed to complete an orbit and compare sidereal and synodic periods, distinguishing orbital revolution from rotation about the body's own axis.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue el tiempo necesario para orbitar otro cuerpo del tiempo que tarda un cuerpo en girar sobre sí mismo.

##### Rotación síncrona

[synchronousRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/synchronousRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how spin–orbit coupling can produce a repeating orientation toward an orbital partner.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica por qué algunos cuerpos mantienen casi siempre la misma cara orientada hacia el cuerpo que orbitan.

### Objetos cósmicos

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[cosmicObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/cosmicObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An overview of what kinds of physical objects and extended structures exist beyond Earth and how they are identified and organized. It teaches classification across cosmic scales and distinguishes an object's physical nature from its environment or apparent visual form; detailed physics belongs to the specialized planetary, stellar, galactic and cosmological domains.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora los distintos tipos de objetos y estructuras del universo y cómo los clasifican los astrónomos.

#### Familias de objetos

Skills: 4

[objectFamilies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/objectFamilies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classification of astronomical entities requires more than their appearance in a photograph: a point source, a diffuse cloud, a cluster and an extended galaxy may be distinguished by physical evidence and scale.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende cómo los astrónomos reconocen distintos tipos de objetos por sus propiedades físicas, no solo por su apariencia.

##### Clasificación de objetos celestes

[celestialObjectClassification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/celestialObjectClassification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify astronomical sources as stellar bodies, planetary bodies, compact remnants, diffuse clouds, star clusters, galaxies or other broad physical types using characteristic evidence rather than appearance alone.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce las principales categorías de objetos celestes por sus propiedades físicas.

##### Objetos difusos y compuestos

[diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate diffuse nebulae, gravitationally associated groups and composite galaxies by their constituents, structure and binding rather than surface resemblance.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue nubes de gas, grupos de estrellas y galaxias por su composición y organización.

##### Objetos y fenómenos

[objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish enduring physical objects and systems from observed events or effects such as eclipses, meteors, flares and transient brightenings, even when both occur in object catalogs.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue un objeto celeste duradero de un suceso como un eclipse o una erupción.

##### Límites entre estrellas, objetos subestelares y planetas

[stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare physically distinct stars, brown dwarfs and planetary-mass bodies using fusion and mass constraints while acknowledging uncertainties near classification boundaries.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora las diferencias entre estrellas, enanas marrones y planetas, incluso donde sus categorías se solapan.

#### Organización y pertenencia

Skills: 3

[organizationAndMembership.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/organizationAndMembership.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's membership in a system is a different property from its type; the same class of object can be gravitationally bound, ejected or found in a sparse galactic environment.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo los objetos forman parte de sistemas astronómicos mayores o se desplazan de manera independiente.

##### Planetas errantes

[freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain planetary-mass objects not gravitationally bound to a host star, including proposed ejection or isolated-formation origins and detection by microlensing or thermal infrared emission; distinguish low illumination from a complete absence of radiation.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende cómo pueden formarse, desplazarse y detectarse los planetas que no orbitan una estrella anfitriona.

##### Sistemas ligados gravitacionalmente

[gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish satellite systems, planetary systems, multiple stars, star clusters, galaxies and galaxy clusters by physical membership and characteristic scales.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara sistemas planetarios, cúmulos estelares, galaxias y otros sistemas unidos por la gravedad.

##### Pertenencia y aislamiento de los objetos

[objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an astronomical object is a member of a larger bound system or is apparently isolated, and explain why gravitational context does not by itself determine intrinsic object type.

**User-friendly description (es):** Averigua si un objeto pertenece a un sistema mayor sin confundir esa relación con el tipo de objeto que es.

### Cosmología

Groups: 5 · Skills: 17

[cosmology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Cosmology tests models for the Universe's large-scale composition, history and expansion using observations with known horizons and uncertainties. Unresolved questions must remain distinguishable from established evidence.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga la expansión, la historia y la estructura a gran escala del Universo mediante pruebas astronómicas.

#### Componentes cósmicos y límites

Skills: 3

[cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational and expansion measurements constrain otherwise unseen components, while cosmological parameters and theoretical uncertainties limit the interpretations that can be supported by available evidence.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende cómo las mediciones cósmicas señalan componentes y preguntas que aún no podemos explicar por completo.

##### Pruebas de la energía oscura

[darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why observations of accelerated expansion motivate a dark-energy component or changes to gravitational models.

**User-friendly description (es):** Examina las pruebas de que la expansión del Universo se está acelerando.

##### Pruebas de la materia oscura

[darkMatterEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkMatterEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dynamical, lensing and cosmological evidence for unseen gravitating mass while recognizing remaining theoretical alternatives.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué los astrónomos deducen la existencia de materia invisible mediante pruebas gravitatorias.

##### Límites del conocimiento cosmológico

[limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish empirical constraints from open problems concerning early conditions, dark components and the global extent of the Universe.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue lo que las observaciones demuestran sobre el Universo de las grandes preguntas sin responder.

#### Expansión cósmica

Skills: 4

[cosmicExpansion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/cosmicExpansion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Large-scale redshift patterns support an evolving cosmic geometry, not an ordinary explosion into pre-existing empty space.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre qué revelan las observaciones sobre la expansión del Universo.

##### Modelos cosmológicos

[cosmologicalModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the predictions and assumptions of simplified expanding-Universe models against observations.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara modelos de expansión del Universo, sus supuestos y predicciones.

##### Corrimiento al rojo cosmológico

[cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain wavelength stretching associated with the expansion of space, distinguishing it from local Doppler motion.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo la expansión del espacio estira la longitud de onda de la luz que viaja.

##### Expansión y sistemas ligados

[expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why the expansion of the Universe does not automatically enlarge gravitationally bound local systems.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué el espacio en expansión no separa simplemente planetas, estrellas o galaxias.

##### Relación de Hubble–Lemaître

[hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate galaxy recession measurements and distance to empirical evidence for expansion within its domain of applicability.

**User-friendly description (es):** Relaciona las distancias medidas de galaxias y sus corrimientos al rojo con la expansión cósmica.

#### Escalas cósmicas

Skills: 4

[cosmicScales.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/cosmicScales.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distances and times become linked by the finite speed of light, which limits how much of the Universe can be observed.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora las inmensas distancias y los tiempos implicados en observar el cosmos.

##### Medidas de distancia cósmica

[cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common cosmological distance concepts when relating observed brightness, redshift and scale.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara las distintas formas de definir y medir distancias en cosmología.

##### Horizontes cósmicos

[cosmicHorizons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicHorizons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret limits on observable or causally connected regions without treating them as physical walls.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora los límites de hasta dónde pueden llegarnos señales o influir en otras regiones.

##### Tiempo de retrospección

[lookbackTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/lookbackTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why distant observations show objects at earlier cosmic epochs.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué mirar más lejos en el espacio significa también mirar hacia el pasado.

##### Universo observable

[observableUniverse.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/observableUniverse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the observable region set by signal travel and cosmic history from claims about the entire Universe.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué el Universo observable no es necesariamente todo el Universo.

#### Estructura y evolución cósmica

Skills: 2

[cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Density perturbations, gravity and cosmic expansion shape the cosmic web over time. This branch focuses on spatial organization and dynamical evolution, as distinct from the initial hot state or the physical nature of the Universe's dark components.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga cómo la gravedad da forma a grandes estructuras a lo largo de la historia cósmica.

##### Formación de estructuras cósmicas

[cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how initially small matter-density differences grow into galaxies and large-scale structure.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo pequeñas diferencias iniciales en la densidad de materia se convirtieron en estructuras cósmicas.

##### Red cósmica

[cosmicWeb.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicWeb.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how filaments, clusters and voids trace the large-scale distribution of matter.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora la enorme red de filamentos galácticos, cúmulos y regiones vacías.

#### Modelos y pruebas del Universo temprano

Skills: 4

[earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The early hot and dense Universe is reconstructed from relic radiation, primordial abundances and theoretical models whose predictions and evidence have different degrees of support.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora las pruebas utilizadas para reconstruir el Universo temprano y caliente.

##### Inflación cósmica

[cosmicInflation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicInflation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the hypothesized early accelerated-expansion phase, distinguish its predicted consequences from direct observation and evaluate what existing cosmic evidence can and cannot establish.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora la idea de la inflación cósmica y distingue sus predicciones de las pruebas confirmadas.

##### Fondo cósmico de microondas

[cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret relic microwave radiation and its spatial variations as evidence about the early Universe.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga el tenue resplandor de microondas que quedó del Universo temprano.

##### Modelo del Big Bang caliente

[hotBigBangModel.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/hotBigBangModel.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the evidence-supported early evolution of the observable Universe without claiming that the model fully explains its ultimate origin.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre qué explica el modelo del Big Bang caliente y qué no demuestra.

##### Nucleosíntesis primordial

[primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the predicted formation of light nuclei and why their observed abundances test early-Universe models.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo los modelos del Universo temprano predicen las cantidades de elementos ligeros.

### La Tierra, la Luna y el Sol

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[earthMoonAndSun.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonAndSun.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Here the distinctive geometry of Earth's viewpoint, rotation and revolution produces observable cycles. The scientific emphasis is on explaining familiar sky events from physical arrangements rather than on general geography or atmospheric meteorology.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo los movimientos y las posiciones de la Tierra, la Luna y el Sol producen patrones conocidos en el cielo.

#### Interacciones entre la Tierra y la Luna

Skills: 3

[earthMoonInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/earthMoonInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Earth–Moon system is a long-term dynamical pair whose interactions create measurable effects on Earth and its satellite.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo la Luna y la Tierra se influyen mutuamente mediante la gravedad.

##### Órbita lunar y mes

[lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the Moon's orbital cycle from the phase cycle by considering Earth's simultaneous revolution around the Sun.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara el recorrido de la Luna alrededor de la Tierra con su ciclo repetitivo de fases.

[lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how tidal dissipation affects Earth's rotation and the Moon's orbital distance over long timescales.

**User-friendly description (es):** Observa cómo las interacciones de marea cambian lentamente la rotación de la Tierra y la órbita de la Luna.

[oceanTides.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/oceanTides.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the dominant lunar and solar gravitational contributions to periodic changes in sea level, distinguishing ideal equilibrium tides from local coastal conditions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo la Luna y el Sol contribuyen a producir las mareas oceánicas.

[eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Occultation and shadow phenomena depend on an observer's line of sight and the relative positions and apparent sizes of bodies.

[eclipseSeasons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/eclipseSeasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why solar and lunar eclipses are not observed at every new or full Moon, using orbital inclination and alignment.

[lunarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/lunarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions and stages of a lunar eclipse as the Moon encounters Earth's shadow.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo la Tierra proyecta su sombra sobre la Luna durante un eclipse lunar.

##### Eclipses solares

[solarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/solarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions, shadow regions and different observational appearances of a solar eclipse.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica cuándo ocurre un eclipse solar y por qué se ve de manera distinta según el lugar.

[lunarLibration.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarLibration.data.ts)

[lunarMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarMotion.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Sigue cómo cambia la posición de la Luna respecto a las estrellas de una noche a otra.

[lunarPhases.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarPhases.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the repeating illuminated shapes visible from Earth through the Sun–Moon–observer geometry.

[nearAndFarLunarHemispheres.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/nearAndFarLunarHemispheres.data.ts)

#### Ciclos del cielo terrestre

Skills: 4

[terrestrialSkyCycles.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/terrestrialSkyCycles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Earth's orientation with respect to sunlight generates daily and annual changes in the visible sky and the duration of daylight.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo la rotación de la Tierra y la inclinación de su eje influyen en la duración del día y los cambios estacionales.

##### Día y noche

[dayAndNight.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/skills/dayAndNight.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the alternation of illumination and darkness through Earth's rotation rather than the Sun physically circling Earth.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica por qué la rotación de la Tierra hace que se alternen la luz del día y la oscuridad de la noche.

##### Las estaciones

[seasons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/skills/seasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain seasonal solar illumination using Earth's axial tilt and orbital revolution rather than changes in Earth–Sun distance alone.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo la inclinación del eje terrestre da lugar a las estaciones.

##### Altura del Sol y duración del día

[solarAltitudeAndDaylight.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/skills/solarAltitudeAndDaylight.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the Sun's apparent height and daily path to latitude, date and daylight duration.

**User-friendly description (es):** Observa cómo cambian la altura aparente del Sol y la duración del día según el lugar y la estación.

##### Solsticios y equinoccios

[solsticesAndEquinoxes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/skills/solsticesAndEquinoxes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain these seasonal reference points from the changing Sun–Earth geometry and the distribution of daylight.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué los solsticios y los equinoccios son momentos especiales del año.

### Sistemas exoplanetarios

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[exoplanetarySystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetarySystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Planetary systems beyond the Sun provide evidence about the diversity of worlds and formation outcomes. Detection, physical inference and habitability are separated to avoid treating an apparent signal as proof of a specific environment.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora los planetas fuera del Sistema Solar y lo que sus descubrimientos revelan sobre otros sistemas planetarios.

#### Caracterización de exoplanetas

Skills: 5

[exoplanetCharacterization.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetCharacterization/exoplanetCharacterization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Planet properties are inferred by combining signals and interpreting assumptions, with important differences between measured quantities and theoretical models.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende cómo los investigadores deducen las propiedades de los exoplanetas a partir de observaciones indirectas.

[exoplanetAtmosphericSpectra.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetCharacterization/skills/exoplanetAtmosphericSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret transit or emission spectra as evidence about atmospheric constituents and conditions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Observa cómo el espectro de un planeta ofrece pistas sobre su atmósfera.

[exoplanetBulkComposition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetCharacterization/skills/exoplanetBulkComposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate a planet's mass-radius behavior to plausible internal materials while recognizing model degeneracy.

**User-friendly description (es):** Usa la masa y el radio para investigar posibles materiales de un planeta sin asumir una única respuesta.

##### Masa de los exoplanetas

[exoplanetMass.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetCharacterization/skills/exoplanetMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a planet's mass from orbital effects, including limits set by viewing geometry and models.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo los efectos gravitatorios de un planeta ayudan a estimar su masa.

##### Propiedades orbitales de exoplanetas

[exoplanetOrbitalProperties.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetCharacterization/skills/exoplanetOrbitalProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer or compare orbital period, eccentricity and star–planet distance using available data.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara los períodos, las formas y los tamaños de las órbitas de exoplanetas.

##### Radio de exoplanetas

[exoplanetRadius.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetCharacterization/skills/exoplanetRadius.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a planet's size from transit or other observations and explain its dependence on stellar parameters.

**User-friendly description (es):** Estima el tamaño de un planeta distante mediante un tránsito y la información sobre su estrella.

Skills: 4

[exoplanetDetection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetDetection/exoplanetDetection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Finding planets around distant stars relies on measured effects and each method has a characteristic sensitivity and ambiguity.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre los métodos que usan los astrónomos para encontrar planetas alrededor de estrellas distantes.

##### Obtención de imágenes directas

[directImaging.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetDetection/skills/directImaging.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain when a planet can be resolved separately from its host star and why brightness contrast is challenging.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué es difícil fotografiar un planeta junto a su brillante estrella anfitriona.

##### Microlente gravitacional

[gravitationalMicrolensing.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetDetection/skills/gravitationalMicrolensing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how temporary lensing signatures can reveal otherwise difficult-to-detect planetary companions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo la gravedad puede aumentar temporalmente el brillo aparente de una estrella distante y revelar un planeta.

[radialVelocityDetection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetDetection/skills/radialVelocityDetection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret periodic stellar spectral shifts as evidence for an orbiting companion and constrain its mass.

**User-friendly description (es):** Utiliza los cambios espectrales del movimiento de una estrella para deducir el tirón de un planeta en órbita.

[transitDetection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetDetection/skills/transitDetection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how repeated stellar dimming can indicate a planet crossing a star's disk and why geometry matters.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce cómo una caída repetida en el brillo estelar puede indicar el paso de un planeta frente a su estrella.

Skills: 4

[systemDiversity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/systemDiversity/systemDiversity.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cuánto pueden diferir otros sistemas planetarios del nuestro.

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the range of stellar irradiation permitting surface liquid water under stated atmospheric assumptions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende qué puede indicar la zona habitable de una estrella sobre el agua líquida y qué no puede indicar.

##### Arquitecturas de sistemas exoplanetarios

[exoplanetSystemArchitectures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/systemDiversity/skills/exoplanetSystemArchitectures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare tightly packed, resonant, eccentric and other planetary arrangements using orbital evidence.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara sistemas con planetas muy próximos, órbitas inusuales o resonancias orbitales.

##### Límites de los indicadores de habitabilidad

[limitsOfHabitabilityIndicators.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/systemDiversity/skills/limitsOfHabitabilityIndicators.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate why receiving suitable starlight or being Earth-sized does not establish a habitable world.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce por qué un planeta del tamaño de la Tierra en una órbita adecuada no es automáticamente habitable.

##### Migración planetaria

[planetaryMigration.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/systemDiversity/skills/planetaryMigration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how interactions with disks or other planets can change orbital locations after formation.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo los planetas pueden desplazarse a otras órbitas después de formarse.

### Astronomía interestelar y galáctica

Groups: 4 · Skills: 16

It treats the sky as an observable system while distinguishing apparent motion from the physical causes developed in celestial mechanics.

**Methodological description (English):** Compare how bright celestial objects look from Earth without equating observed brightness with intrinsic luminosity.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara lo brillantes que se ven los astros desde la Tierra sin confundir ese brillo con la cantidad de luz que realmente emiten.

##### Asterismos

[asterisms.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/asterisms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize named visual star patterns that can cross constellation boundaries and distinguish them from officially defined regions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Identifica patrones conocidos de estrellas que no son necesariamente constelaciones oficiales.

##### Constelaciones

[constellations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/constellations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use officially defined regions of the celestial sphere to locate objects without assuming their member stars form a physical cluster.

**User-friendly description (es):** Usa las regiones de las constelaciones para localizar objetos sin suponer que sus estrellas están físicamente cerca unas de otras.

##### Movimiento diario aparente del cielo

[dailySkyMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/dailySkyMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the apparent east-to-west paths of celestial objects across the sky, including circumpolar paths.

**User-friendly description (es):** Describe cómo parecen desplazarse las estrellas por el cielo durante el día o la noche.

##### Visibilidad estacional del cielo

[seasonalSkyVisibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/seasonalSkyVisibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why different stars and constellations become visible at different times of the year.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica por qué se ven diferentes patrones de estrellas en distintas estaciones.

##### Movimiento propio estelar

[stellarProperMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/stellarProperMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the slow positional motion of a star relative to distant background sources and distinguish this physical change from the daily apparent rotation of the sky.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce el movimiento muy lento de una estrella respecto a otras más lejanas.

### Ciencia planetaria

Groups: 4 · Skills: 18

[planetaryScience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Planetary science compares worlds by their surfaces, interiors, atmospheres and volatile materials. It uses Earth as one comparative case, but its categories also apply to moons, dwarf planets and worlds beyond the Solar System.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga de qué están hechos los mundos y cómo funcionan sus superficies, atmósferas e interiores.

#### Atmósferas y tiempo meteorológico

Skills: 4

[atmospheresAndWeather.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/atmospheresAndWeather.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Atmospheric behavior depends on composition, gravity, radiation, pressure and circulation in ways that vary widely from Earth.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué distintos planetas tienen atmósferas y condiciones meteorológicas tan diferentes.

##### Circulación atmosférica

[atmosphericCirculation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/atmosphericCirculation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate global winds and thermal patterns to solar input, rotation and atmospheric structure.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo la rotación y el calentamiento de un planeta dan forma a los movimientos del aire a gran escala.

##### Retención y escape de la atmósfera

[atmosphericRetentionAndEscape.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/atmosphericRetentionAndEscape.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how gravity, temperature and escape processes influence the presence or loss of planetary atmospheres.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica por qué algunos mundos conservan atmósferas densas mientras otros pierden gases hacia el espacio.

##### Efectos invernadero planetarios

[planetaryGreenhouseEffects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/planetaryGreenhouseEffects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how atmospheric absorption and emission influence surface or atmospheric temperatures on different worlds.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo los gases atmosféricos retienen y liberan calor en diferentes planetas.

##### Meteorología planetaria

[planetaryWeather.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/planetaryWeather.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify and interpret weather phenomena such as storms, clouds and winds under non-Earth conditions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce tormentas, vientos y nubes en mundos con condiciones distintas a las de la Tierra.

#### Interiores y materiales volátiles

Skills: 5

[interiorsAndVolatiles.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/interiorsAndVolatiles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Indirect observations of magnetic fields, heat and fluid materials constrain unseen layers and possible activity beneath planetary surfaces.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga las capas internas ocultas, los campos magnéticos, el agua y el hielo de los mundos planetarios.

[cryovolcanism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/cryovolcanism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize and explain eruptions driven by volatile liquids and ices rather than molten rock.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo los mundos fríos pueden expulsar hielo o materiales volátiles en lugar de roca fundida.

##### Estructura interna de los planetas

[planetaryInteriorStructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/planetaryInteriorStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer cores, mantles or other layers from density, seismic, magnetic and gravitational evidence.

**User-friendly description (es):** Utiliza pruebas indirectas para explorar el núcleo y las capas internas de un planeta.

##### Campos magnéticos planetarios

[planetaryMagneticFields.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/planetaryMagneticFields.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions under which internal conductive flows can generate global or regional magnetic fields.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica cómo el material conductor en movimiento dentro de un planeta puede generar un campo magnético.

##### Océanos subterráneos

[subsurfaceOceans.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/subsurfaceOceans.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret geophysical and compositional evidence for liquids beneath icy surfaces without assuming biology.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga las pistas que indican que algunas lunas heladas podrían ocultar océanos líquidos.

##### Agua y hielo fuera de la Tierra

[waterAndIceBeyondEarth.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/waterAndIceBeyondEarth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the physical states and likely reservoirs of water on different Solar System bodies.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora dónde pueden existir agua y hielo en otros mundos.

#### Clases de cuerpos planetarios

Skills: 5

[planetaryClasses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/planetaryClasses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Composition, density and thermal history help explain why planets and moons display very different structures rather than simply different sizes.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara mundos rocosos, planetas gigantes, lunas y otros cuerpos planetarios.

##### Planetas gigantes

[giantPlanets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/giantPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish gas giants from ice giants using composition, interior models and observable atmospheric properties.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue los gigantes gaseosos de los gigantes helados por su composición y estructura interna.

##### Satélites naturales

[naturalSatellites.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/naturalSatellites.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare moons by origin, orbit, composition and geological activity without treating all satellites as Moon-like.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo varían las lunas en tamaño, origen, composición y actividad.

##### Densidad y composición planetaria

[planetaryDensityAndComposition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/planetaryDensityAndComposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use mass, radius and density to constrain plausible bulk material and planetary classification.

**User-friendly description (es):** Usa la masa, el tamaño y la densidad de un mundo para deducir de qué puede estar compuesto.

##### Sistemas de anillos planetarios

[planetaryRingSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/planetaryRingSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the composition, dynamics, formation and evolution of rings around planets or other bodies, including interactions with nearby satellites and differences between dense rings and diffuse dust populations.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo se forman y cambian los anillos de los planetas y cómo interactúan con lunas cercanas.

##### Planetas terrestres

[terrestrialPlanets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/terrestrialPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the characteristic rocky interiors, surfaces and atmospheres of Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué Mercurio, Venus, la Tierra y Marte son planetas rocosos con condiciones distintas.

#### Superficies y geología

Skills: 4

[surfacesAndGeology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/surfacesAndGeology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observable terrain records impacts, deformation, volcanism and erosion, with interpretation conditioned by the limits of remote data.

[extraterrestrialVolcanism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/extraterrestrialVolcanism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret evidence of past or current volcanic processes on planets and moons.

**User-friendly description (es):** Busca señales de volcanes en mundos más allá de la Tierra.

[impactCratering.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/impactCratering.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how collisions produce craters and why crater populations can reveal relative surface history.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo las colisiones crean cráteres y qué revelan sus patrones.

##### Tectónica planetaria

[planetaryTectonics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/planetaryTectonics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare crustal deformation and tectonic regimes across worlds without assuming Earth-style plate tectonics everywhere.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara cómo las cortezas de distintos mundos se doblan, fracturan o desplazan.

[surfaceAgeEstimation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/surfaceAgeEstimation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use relative geologic relationships and calibrated crater statistics to infer the chronology of planetary surfaces.

**User-friendly description (es):** Estima cuándo se formaron las superficies mediante relaciones geológicas y cráteres de impacto.

### Astronomía solar

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[solarAstronomy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarAstronomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Sun is examined as a physical star whose radiation, plasma and magnetism affect the Solar System. Stellar populations and the Sun's long-term evolutionary fate are treated in stellar astronomy.

**User-friendly description (es):** Estudia el Sol como una estrella y explora cómo su energía y actividad influyen en el sistema solar.

#### Efectos heliosféricos

Skills: 4

[heliosphericEffects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/heliosphericEffects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Solar material and magnetic fields extend outward and can influence planetary space environments even far from the solar surface.

**User-friendly description (es):** Investiga cómo las partículas solares y los campos magnéticos afectan al espacio circundante.

[auroralProcesses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/skills/auroralProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how energetic charged particles interacting with an atmosphere and magnetic field produce auroral emissions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica cómo las partículas cargadas y los gases de la atmósfera interactúan para producir auroras.

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the region dominated by the solar wind and distinguish its boundary from a solid surface.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre la enorme región del espacio influida por el viento solar.

##### Viento solar

[solarWind.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/skills/solarWind.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the outward flow of charged solar particles and their transport of magnetic fields through space.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora la corriente de partículas cargadas que fluye desde el Sol hacia el espacio.

[spaceWeather.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/skills/spaceWeather.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret solar-driven changes that can affect spacecraft, radio systems and near-Earth space without equating them with terrestrial weather.

Skills: 4

[magneticActivity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/magneticActivity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Magnetic fields in solar plasma produce time-variable surface features and energetic events rather than a perfectly steady star.

[solarActivityCycle.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/skills/solarActivityCycle.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret periodic trends in solar magnetic activity without assuming identical cycles.

**User-friendly description (es):** Sigue los cambios de la actividad solar sin suponer que todos los ciclos son iguales.

##### Fulguraciones solares

[solarFlares.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/skills/solarFlares.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe rapid magnetic-energy release and its observable radiation signatures.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo los cambios rápidos de los campos magnéticos producen fulguraciones solares.

##### Manchas solares

[sunspots.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/skills/sunspots.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the relation between dark solar surface regions, strong magnetic fields and relative temperature.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué las manchas solares se ven más oscuras y cómo se relacionan con los campos magnéticos.

Skills: 4

[solarStructureAndEnergy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/solarStructureAndEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Solar radiation originates from processes in the interior and travels outward through distinct plasma and atmospheric regions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo la energía viaja desde el interior del Sol hasta el espacio que lo rodea.

[solarAtmosphere.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarAtmosphere.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the photosphere, chromosphere and corona by their observational features and physical conditions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce las distintas capas visibles y externas de la atmósfera del Sol.

[solarInterior.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarInterior.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora las capas internas del Sol y cómo transportan la energía.

[solarLuminosity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarLuminosity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the Sun's total radiant output and its relationship to illumination received at different distances.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende la energía total que emite el Sol y cómo cambia la luz recibida con la distancia.

[solarNuclearFusion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarNuclearFusion.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica por qué la fusión nuclear, y no la combustión común, proporciona energía al Sol.

### Estructura y origen del Sistema Solar

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[formationAndChronology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/formationAndChronology.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Examina las pruebas de cómo el Sistema Solar se formó y cambió con el tiempo.

[planetaryAccretion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/skills/planetaryAccretion.data.ts)

[protoplanetaryDisks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/skills/protoplanetaryDisks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a small body in space, its atmospheric luminous phenomenon and surviving material reaching the ground.

[transNeptunianObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/minorBodies/skills/transNeptunianObjects.data.ts)

[innerAndOuterSolarSystem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/systemArchitecture/skills/innerAndOuterSolarSystem.data.ts)

[solarSystemComponents.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/systemArchitecture/skills/solarSystemComponents.data.ts)
